snippet.title: V1.2 Music Update! | Supermarket Cola Dash Classic
snippet.description:
Note: One of the chord notes has been removed in V1.2.1 to make the song better
This is an endless runner style game I made a while ago, I added music to it recently! It is a rather basic loop, but I said I would add it about 2 years ago so I have now.
Try to get 100+ points if you can!
https://camer-the-dragon.itch.io/supermarket-cola-dash
